title: Pet Premium Shock Triage
oneLiner: A calm decision board for pet owners facing sudden insurance hikes, showing switch risks, claim history tradeoffs, and complaint options.
targetUser: Pet owners who just received a steep renewal increase and need to decide whether to keep coverage, raise deductibles, switch insurers, self-insure, or file a state complaint without accidentally losing pre-existing-condition protection.
keyUx: Enter current premium, renewal jump, pet age/breed, claim history, deductible, reimbursement rate, quoted alternatives, and known conditions; the app compares scenarios, warns about switch traps, prepares insurer/state complaint notes, and produces a family-safe decision memo.
requiredUiSections: pet health and claim history timeline

externalSignals.title: Reddit r/petinsurancereviews — Embrace Pet Insurance Premium Increased by 84%
Reddit r/petinsurancereviews — monthly price increase / Healthy Paws more than doubling

stitchPrompt: Design a responsive consumer decision product called Pet Premium Shock Triage for pet owners who just received a steep insurance renewal increase. Users should enter current premium, renewal jump, pet age and breed, claim history, deductible, reimbursement rate, quoted alternatives, and known conditions; the app compares keep, switch, deductible-change, and self-insure scenarios, warns about pre-existing-condition traps, prepares insurer or state complaint notes, and produces a family-safe decision memo. Include a premium shock intake, pet health and claim history timeline, keep/switch/self-insure scenario cards, pre-existing-condition trap warnings, deductible and reimbursement slider, state complaint note builder, and family decision memo. Design direction: use a calm-consumer aesthetic with warm neutral cards, gentle teal accents, low-stress comparison language, soft pet-health timelines, and clear next-step buttons so the product feels protective and emotionally steady during a money panic.
